meta.title: Direction North Digital Marketing — Case Study | Teknoppy
meta.description: How Teknoppy runs social media campaigns and community handling for Direction North, a Kerala retail display and visual merchandising manufacturer, across Instagram and Facebook.

meta.label: Key Services
meta.value: Digital Marketing, Social Media Campaign Management, Social Media Handling

paragraphs.text: Direction North is a Kerala-based retail display and visual merchandising manufacturer, producing floor displays, store transformations, exhibition builds, and premium retail branding for client brands.

paragraphs.html: Note: this case study is scoped to social media campaign running and handling — see the separate website structure/SEO case study for this client for the website work.

items.title: No consistent showcase of completed work
items.text: Retail display and store transformation projects are inherently visual, but without a content plan, that proof of work likely wasn't being shared consistently as an ongoing portfolio.

items.title: No visible brand-credibility signals
items.text: Serving established retail brands is a strong trust signal for a B2B buyer, but without deliberate content, those brand associations likely weren't visible to prospects browsing the company's social channels.

items.title: Inconsistent posting across Instagram and Facebook
items.text: Without a structured calendar, presence was likely sporadic, limiting visibility to a B2B audience actively researching display and merchandising vendors.

paragraphs.text: Teknoppy's goal was to run social media campaigns and community handling across Instagram and Facebook that could turn genuinely visual, project-based work into a consistent content presence — the kind of ongoing portfolio a B2B buyer evaluating display vendors actually wants to see.

sections.h2: A comprehensive range of services offered by Teknoppy and their outcomes

items.title: Project showcase content
items.text: Installation photos, store transformation before/afters, and exhibition builds are shared as a structured content series, turning completed work into an ongoing visual portfolio.

items.title: Brand association surfaced through content
items.text: Content highlights the caliber of brands and projects the company has delivered for, building credibility for prospective B2B buyers evaluating vendors.

items.title: A structured content calendar across Instagram and Facebook
items.text: Consistent posting keeps the brand visible to retail and brand-marketing decision-makers researching display partners.

items.title: Community handling
items.text: Enquiries and engagement on both channels are actively managed, turning social interest into sales conversations.

paragraphs.text: Discovery, content planning, and campaign specifics for this engagement — timeline and key decisions — should be pulled from the project intake and added here once confirmed.
